sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
The petitioners are A-1 and A-2 in the above crime.
A case under Sections 273, 420 r/w 34 IPC and under Sections 58, 59, 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was registered against them in the above crime.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this is a covered matter in view of the earlier common orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch and Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch.
Therefore, he would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of the F.I.R.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would fairly concede that this is a covered matter in view of the above earlier orders of this Court.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate orders accordingly in this Criminal Petition also.
Resultantly, this Criminal Petition is allowed in view of the aforesaid common orders passed by this Court based on identical facts and allegations.
Consequently, the above F.I.R registered against the petitioners is hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, in the Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
